<!-- classic-function-body-inline-checkpoint -->
Integrate native Code Intelligence 0.5.0 with retained TypeScript 0.3.0 and the
GitHub App workflows. Optional compiler/provider/runtime operations retain host
authority. Source bytes, immutable snapshots and original observations remain
authoritative. This remains an active draft; full STATUS/R1-R9 acceptance is open.

## Resulting behavior

- The existing optional `inlineCompiler` profile now expands finite classic
  function bodies into caller statements. Complete initializer/return/expression
  calls evaluate arguments once before parameter initialization. Defaults, rest,
  patterns, optional types, inferred anonymous names and contextual typing are
  checked. Labelled returns retain nested returns and finally overrides; normal
  completion clears a return cancelled by finally break/continue. Native source
  reconstruction, original binding coverage and declaration type coverage precede
  ordinary guarded plans. The body route refuses direct eval through parentheses,
  escapes and TypeScript assertions/instantiations. The separate actual compiler
  variable-inline action and existing LSP routes retain their contracts.
- TypeScript 5.8.3 declaration moves target captured ES modules with checked
  reexport partitions, fresh import aliases, omitted named/default/namespace
  imports and source-owned dependency exports. Exact relative linkage, original
  byte composition, property semantics and complete-result bindings/API checks
  precede independent verification, approval, application and conditional recovery.
- Native Meaning identity, mixed graph queries/composition and packet-qualified
  outcomes preserve directed parallel observations, original source/receipt
  evidence and ordered roles. Explicit model adjudication and transcript
  candidates use durable accounting/replay; labels establish no semantic truth
  or observed execution. Candidates create no outcome events.
- Git/GitHub workflows cover captured impact/ownership/conflict pages, verified
  local history, closed-PR observations, approved digest submission, authenticated
  intake and separately authorized queries. App-bound persistent history retains
  signed original plans and exact revisions. Received declarations/interpretations
  require independent local correspondence. No production App service is installed.
- Mixed documents, selected PostgreSQL catalogs and reviewed Neo4j/FalkorDB
  publication retain separate contracts and qualifications. Receipt-owned host
  configuration and managed installation preserve guarded recovery. The d819d71
  Ubuntu installer-fixture failures were corrected at a6bbe2c; its hosted Ubuntu
  Rust job passed. Remaining platform failures retain their original evidence.

Default retrieval starts no model or analyzed project code. Compiler preparation
executes the explicitly trusted host worker. Runtime regression comparisons and
verification commands execute owned literal fixtures under explicit test authority.

## Validation and evidence boundaries

| Scope | Actual result |
| --- | --- |
| Latest body/compiler-project groups, final-r3 | 14 passed / 0 failed, two groups on 805 fixed native inputs |
| Latest format/build/all-target Clippy `-D warnings` | Passed |
| Before final SDK wrapper extension, guard-final-r1 | Four unit passes; 82 integration passes / two existing gates ignored |
| Preceding broader snapshot, final-r2 | 668 passed / 0 failed / nine existing ignored across 14 groups |
| Latest retained checks on 799 fixed inputs | Python17, typecheck, TypeScript260 passed / three existing skips |
| Positive CLI gates | Two independent tsc/approval/apply/foreign-preserving recovery scenarios |
| Direct-eval protection | Nine refusal scenarios; four real CLI probes leave zero plan/report/derived snapshots |
| Metadata after runtime freeze | Python17; 805 native and 798 other retained inputs exact; only allowed R1 tracker fields changed |

These are distinct frozen source sets and overlapping scopes; counts are not
added. Ignored entries are not passes. Earlier default/contextual typing, finally
and eval regression failures remain indexed with their corrected checks. The
final wrapper extension uses actual pinned TypeScript5.8.3 `isOuterExpression`.
Its real CLI probes retain exact executable hashes before/after use. Synthetic
worker prototypes explicitly claim no native admission.

Source `a0794a82afc06f5195b5226fc4055ae72a3f7aea`; current head `51e3b3509f7a6c7208eda5374aa3e70900d5abb0`. The evidence index binds
343 raw artifacts, SHA-256 `ff1a11191e14ec168d6c8ed3e34fc86112a4b2e7492c2af45c095f8379b1b845`.

- [Current STATUS](https://github.com/HECer/Yoke-CodeIntelligence/blob/51e3b3509f7a6c7208eda5374aa3e70900d5abb0/docs/STATUS.md)
- [Remaining R1-R9 work](https://github.com/HECer/Yoke-CodeIntelligence/blob/51e3b3509f7a6c7208eda5374aa3e70900d5abb0/docs/REMAINING_WORK.md)
- [Compiler inline contract](https://github.com/HECer/Yoke-CodeIntelligence/blob/51e3b3509f7a6c7208eda5374aa3e70900d5abb0/native/docs/compiler-inline.md)
- [Current immutable evidence](https://github.com/HECer/Yoke-CodeIntelligence/blob/51e3b3509f7a6c7208eda5374aa3e70900d5abb0/docs/validation/integration-2026-10-19/function-body-inline/README.md)
- [Earlier integration evidence](https://github.com/HECer/Yoke-CodeIntelligence/blob/51e3b3509f7a6c7208eda5374aa3e70900d5abb0/docs/validation/integration-2026-10-19/README.md)

## Remaining qualification

Var hoisting and wider invocation/expression/declaration/language/consumer forms
remain open, alongside unsupported move attributes/sibling bundles, wider semantic
quality, authenticated/media routes and upstream equivalence. Existing OS1314 and
macOS PDF/runtime/timing failures remain unresolved. Production App deployment,
whole-native/full Windows acceptance and fresh-head hosted acceptance are not
certified by these scoped checks. All inventory identities and false full-contract
certifications remain. No main merge or separate release publisher is performed.
